hold.label: Hold under pushes
hold.desc: Palm locked 30 cm up, gravity on, random 0.03 N pushes on each stick every 0.1 s, 0.02 rad start-joint noise. 10 s.

pick.label: Pick, carry and place
pick.desc: chops V4 stage C: the palm descends 5 cm onto a 30 mm cube, lifts it 6 cm, carries it 10 cm to B, lowers it, and the sticks must let go. 10.5 s.

entries.label: Scripted grip
entries.desc: No policy: the fingers hold the MuJoCo grip and only the palm moves. The baseline every trained policy must beat.

grip_labs.label: First: closed_v5_mj
grip_labs.desc: First MuJoCo grip, no finger lag. Older, shorter battery.

grip_labs.label: closed_v5_mj2
grip_labs.desc: Firmer thumb and ring-finger pinch on the lower stick, 0.15 s finger lag. ~5 N on the index finger.

grip_labs.label: closed_v5_mj3
grip_labs.desc: The mj2 pinch x1.5. ~8 N on the index finger.

grip_labs.label: closed_v5_mj4 (10 N)
grip_labs.desc: Pinch x2 plus a light upper-stick pinch: ~10 N on the index finger.
